Perpifying the stock markets.

Bringing equities on-chain with continuous synthetic perpetuals, expanding stock listings, and delivering institutional-grade trading tools on Robinhood Chain.

Updated September 2026 · Development Roadmap

{01}

Vision: Perpifying equities.

Traditional equity markets remain constrained by legacy architecture: rigid trading hours (9:30 AM to 4:00 PM EST), multi-day settlement delays (T+1 clearing), geographic barriers, high borrowing costs for shorting, and closed brokerage accounts. Traders face overnight gap risk without the ability to manage their positions in real time.

FloatSheets was built to perpify the stock markets. By pairing synthetic perpetual contracts with a pool-versus-trader model on Robinhood Chain, traders gain direct, 24/7 leveraged long and short exposure to global equities. Every position is backed by attested oracle feeds referenced against Uniswap V3 liquidity, with 100% collateral and settlement denominated in USDG. No brokers, no wrapped asset custody, and no settlement lockups.

{02}

Upcoming stock listings.

Our initial rollout established the core markets across tech giants and volatile movers (NVDA, TSLA, MSTR, RDDT, PLTR, CRCL, HIMS, MU, SPCX, QUBT). The next phase expands the tradable universe into high-demand sectors:

Mega-Cap & High-Beta Tech: Introducing liquid tech staples including Apple (AAPL), Microsoft (MSFT), Amazon (AMZN), and Coinbase (COIN), giving traders direct synthetic exposure to top market leaders.

Community-Nominated Growth: Opening community proposals for high-volume micro-caps and momentum stocks that meet our minimum daily volume and data coverage thresholds.

Guarded Graduation Pipeline: Every newly listed equity begins in a guarded state with lower leverage limits and tighter open-interest caps. As on-chain liquidity depth and oracle confidence establish a track record, markets graduate to standard leverage and expanded capacity.

{03}

Advanced order controls.

Active perp traders require precision risk management. We are deploying native trigger-based order types directly into the execution flow:

Take-Profit & Stop-Loss: Set automated exit thresholds upon opening or on active positions. Orders trigger against attested oracle prices so you can protect capital or capture gains around the clock.

Partial Position Closes: Scale in and out of positions smoothly without being forced to close the entire ticket at once.

Dynamic Margin Management: Add or remove USDG margin from open positions on the fly to adjust liquidation buffers and leverage ratios as price action evolves.

{04}

Trader UX & terminal tools.

The FloatSheets workspace is continuously upgraded with features designed for high-frequency and professional traders:

Pro Multi-Timeframe Charting: Seamless switching between 1-minute, 5-minute, 15-minute, hourly, and daily candles with volume profiles and moving averages.

Visual Risk Bounds: Dynamic liquidation price markers with boundary indicators that preserve candlestick scaling while highlighting dangerous exposure levels.

One-Click Execution & Feedback: Pre-flight contract validation to catch risk rejections before firing wallet signatures, combined with tactile audio-visual confirmations for executions.

Mobile-First Trading Sheet: Streamlined quick-action navigation and thumb-friendly controls for executing on mobile without compromising on analytics.

{05}

Vault scaling & LP depth.

The backbone of FloatSheets is the single-sided USDG liquidity vault. In this phase, we are scaling capacity to accommodate higher institutional notional volume:

Virtual Share Security: Leveraging our hardened v2 FloatVault design with virtual shares and assets to prevent inflation and frontrunning attacks.

Automated Risk Bands: Real-time dynamic spreads and skew-based funding that balance long and short open interest while rewarding LPs for providing stabilizing counterparty capital.

{06}

Decentralized keeper network.

To guarantee system solvency and continuous operation, contract liquidations are being opened to an incentivized keeper network:

Guaranteed Keeper Subsidies: Liquidators receive dedicated execution bounties, ensuring underwater positions are closed promptly even during extreme market volatility.

Open-Source Keeper Bots: Providing reference keeper bot implementations so anyone in the community can run liquidation and monitoring nodes on Robinhood Chain.

The future of on-chain equities.
Trade without boundaries.
